content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps that should be filled before a decision. No witnesses beyond management were interviewed, so there is no corroboration or rebuttal on the yelling in front of others, the \"off the street\" remark, or the requests to sign as witness. Claim 2 (threats) has no evidence at all. On the accommodation claim, the HR Supervisor says she never knew of the request, while Complainant says she asked and got no response. Nobody resolved this, for example through emails, the ergonomic assessment, or the Georgia Vocational Rehabilitation Agency. The HR Supervisor also said she sent Complainant to Employee Labor Relations, which suggests some notice, and that office was never contacted. The medical documentation dates from 2005 and is stale. Comparator evidence on workload, training, and probationary termination is only asserted by the supervisor and not documented. The termination rests on the supervisor's own recommendation, with no records of the performance errors or of how other probationers were treated. Nothing addresses the protected bases beyond the supervisor's denials, and the final decision is conclusory."}
